name: after-sales-support
description: AI after-sales customer service closed loop: emotion detection, product disambiguation (S1 Pro breast pump vs robot vacuum), error-photo OCR, RAG over product/error-code/manual knowledge bases, rule-based self-fix vs escalate decision, and ticket archiving. Rules decide, retrieval grounds, the LLM empathizes; every layer degrades offline via fallback.
author: aflare community

inputs.name: user_message
inputs.default: 我的 S1 Pro 不吸了！明天要开派对，急死了！！

inputs.name: user_clarified
inputs.default: 扫地机器人，派对前要把家里打扫干净

dependencies: optional: tesseract or a vision model for photo OCR (falls back to pre-extracted text); optional: ollama for empathetic LLM replies (falls back to a rule-based reply that still carries the retrieval results)
